name: lovedist
description: Build distributable LÖVE executables for Windows and Linux with one click

lovedist.gameName.description: Base name for the built files (defaults to the workspace folder name).

lovedist.outputDir.description: Output directory for built files, relative to the project root.

lovedist.loveVersion.description: LÖVE version used when auto-downloading the Windows binary.

lovedist.binaries.windows.description: Path to a Windows LÖVE love.exe (or a folder containing it). Empty = auto-download the official win64 build.

lovedist.binaries.linux.description: Path to a Linux LÖVE binary (an ELF executable, not an AppImage). 'love' = use the one installed on this system.
